resources.string: How far apart two cities are, and how long to walk, cycle or drive it, as an estimate and without the model.

• The straight-line distance between two cities, in km and miles
• Roughly how far by road or trail: walking about 30% longer, cycling and driving about 25%
• How many days to walk or cycle it, or hours to drive
• There and back, when you ask for the round trip
How far is it to walk from Paris to Rome and back?
How long would it take to bike from Vienna to Budapest?
What\'s the distance between Madrid and Barcelona?

It knows the 6,000 largest cities (GeoNames, CC BY 4.0) and works from their coordinates, so every answer is an estimate, not a mapped route: it can\'t know roads, borders, ferries or closures. A place that isn\'t one of those cities (a hotel, a beach, a small town) goes to the model as usual, and so does a chat about health, an injury or danger. Questions in English only. Ported from r4to\'s travel distance (BOAR R&D).
